ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a plane projection grid type and 4 x 4 km resolution.
description: Regular 4 km × 4 km Cartesian vertex grid for horizontal velocity variables in the CISM Greenland configuration, using the EPSG:3413 polar stereographic projection (WGS84). The grid consists of 415 × 703 vertices and is staggered by half a grid cell in both horizontal directions relative to the 416 × 704 cell-centre scalar grid. Both horizontal velocity components (u and v) are colocated at these vertices, consistent with the Arakawa B-grid arrangement used by CISM. The projection has a latitude of origin of 90°N, a standard parallel of 70°N, a central meridian of 45°W, and zero false easting and northing.
alias: CISM Greenland 4 km vertex velocity grid
